"This artists' book was co-published by Mossybrook Press in High Falls, New York and Women's Studio Workshop in Rosendale, New York. It was created in a limited edition of 100 with 20 artist's proofs. The prints combine etching, relief printing and chine colle. They are printed on handmade Japanese Kozo paper. The type, Helvetica, is letterpress printed by the artist.The kite structures are based on traditional Japanese kites"--Colophon.

Accompanied by sheet with text, colophon sheet, and instruction sheet by Tal Streeter.

Constructed as a palm leaf style binding, each page of this book is a snapshot of the artists' daily commute down the Rhein river and back. Text and dates comprise the first part of the book, the second half is only image, slightly blurry because they were taken aboard the moving boat.
"...on the subject of books and boats both being containers and means of transport."--http://www.livresdartistes.com.

This minimalist book--just longer than a dollar bill--is written in the imperative : earn desire, earn liberty, earn anxiety, earn foolishness, earn appetite. There's no such thing as a free lunch in the world of this book. Printed Matter.
Artist's book consisting of numerous 2-word phrases beginning with the word "earn".
Full page color illustrations with a text on the history and use of money and its visual components.

"Although it looks like a photo album, this little memorial tribute to Marilyn Monroe is actually an address book. It lists, in chronological order and one entry per page, every known place she lived from birth to death." Printed Matter Inc.

8 miniature books in a wooden box :
Issued in wooden box (21 x 22 x 5 cm) containing 8 miniature books (5 x 5 cm).
Savannah College of Art and Design owns all edition numbers 33/80 of the eight miniature books.
Leaves: The leaf photos are from many different places. The cover paper is made from leaves, the font is Vitsui, the printing is Giclee.
Stars: Star photos are by NASA. The cover paper has mica and micro glitter and title is foil stamped. The font is Helvetica, the printing is Giclee.
Rivers: The river photos are from many differnet places in the West. The cover is Japanese screen printed and Ingres blue paper, the font is Bradley Hand. The printing is Giclee.
Rocks: The cover is real rock. The photographs are from many places. The font is Helvetica, the printing is Giclee.
Rainbows: The cover is printable fabric, the font is Lucida Handwriting, the printing is Giclee.
Clouds: Clouds are magnificent examples of nature's details. The cover is cast paper, the font is Khaki, which has been modified, and the printing is Giclee.
Insects: The cover paper is Dhaka, the ants are stamped and thermal embossed. The font is Auriol, the printing is Giclee.
Beach: The beach details were found along the California and Oregon coasts. The cover is polymer clay and Oregon sand, the font is called "Sand" and the printing is Giclee.
Each minature book has a distinctive title: Beach -- Clouds -- Insects -- Leaves -- Rainbows -- Rivers -- Rocks -- Stars.
Jen Library Special Collections copy is numbered 52 out of 40.
